game_hypotheses.alchimie: A fixed conversion cannot be represented honestly as two ordinary distinct ingredients without multiplicity semantics. No numeric conversion recipe is proposed.
game_hypotheses.conexiuni: A specific duration predicate is semantically tighter than the broad Societate category, but this does not repair or approve held fallback boards. Distinct partition, difficulty and generic-filler checks still apply.
game_hypotheses.contexto: An added incoming arc is not target qualification; the incoming-neighbour floor and nameable-target/feedback gates remain.
game_hypotheses.intrusul: Existing accepted duration trio Secundă/Minut/Oră is already covered. Adding Zi to a unit family does not authorize a near-duplicate board.
game_hypotheses.lant: If independently accepted, missing reverse unit arcs could permit a familiar Zi→Oră→Minut→Secundă direction with truthful conversion captions. Still requires source/rank/route/save/reachability impact checks and alternatives; no journey approval.
game_hypotheses.perechi: Minute–second pair already served; replacing its label or reskinning the same four pairings supplies no fresh round. Mixed adjacent units create competing valid pairings, so a new matching board is not presumed valid.

relation_leads.reason: Exact direct non-distractor edge already encodes the coefficient; the same pair is also served in an approved Perechi board. Do not append another edge or count a new fact/form.
sense_guards: Time duration only; no plane-angle minute/second or ordinal/musical second.
Hour means duration unit, not a school lesson or clock reading.
Day means the defined duration unit; exclude daylight span and any unqualified claim about elapsed local civil/calendar dates.
Do not equate calendar month or calendar year to a fixed number of days/hours.
No aliases/synonyms proposed; existing normalized owners remain unchanged.
relation_leads.source_access_qualification: Numeric conversion directly verified in current primary BIPM; curriculum document supplies pedagogic recognition context, not a numeric coefficient or current-law claim.
